text:
Zoe: FYI - saw a handful of failures in mobile QA where the dashboard table briefly clips rows when the left rail collapses. Repro on iPhone SE / 360px: open /jobs -> tap rail toggle -> last row loses ~5px. GIF: https://redwood-internal.screencaps/clip.gif

Miguel: Oof. Is the clip during the animation or after?

Zoe: During the animation 14 the height recalculates when the browser UI hides, so the table jumps. Also the action popover sometimes appears underneath the rail overlay.

Priya: Sounds like two problems: 100vh-based layout + transform-induced stacking contexts. For the first, switch to using visualViewport.height for JS-driven containers or avoid 100vh. For the second, portal popovers to body and use position: fixed.

Ben: Quick UX question: should the rail be overlay at <=420 or <=440? I've seen Android devices that still squeeze content at 440. Also icon-only at mid sizes would reduce the jump.

Lin: Proposal: three-tier behavior: full rail >=521px, icons-only 441-520px, overlay <=440px. That gives icons-only on narrow tablets and overlay on tiny phones. We should make thresholds CSS vars.

Miguel: Agree. Engineering: if we animate transform on the rail for perf, popovers must be portaled. Also avoid transform on any ancestor of the popover anchor.

Zoe: Small copy/a11y bits: change toggle label to "Open navigation" / "Close navigation" for screen reader clarity. Disable hover tooltips on touch devices; they block taps. Make sure focus trap is applied when overlay is open.

Priya: Also ensure touch hit targets remain >=44px. The chevron action looked visually fine but the tappable area was <44px in QA. Expand padding inside the clickable element rather than increasing row height.

Ben: For animation, can we animate translateX on the rail element but render popovers at a root layer? That should keep the table stable and avoid reflows while preserving smooth animation.

Lin: Yes, and add padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) on the table container so iOS bottom bars don't cover rows. Plus listen for visualViewport resize to avoid 100vh jumps when the address bar changes.

Miguel: I can mock a prototype: overlay rail at <=440, icon-only 441-520, portaled popovers, fixed-position popover when portaled, env() shim, and visualViewport listener. Will also add feature flag to test thresholds. Aim to demo in sandbox by Wed.

Zoe: Great. Design asks: can you include variants for 360, 412, 428, 480 widths in the sandbox and a keyboard-only flow so we can validate focus trap and aria announcements?

Priya: I'll update the toggle copy and tooltip rules. Also will add a11y notes: aria-expanded on the toggle, aria-hidden on main content when overlay active, and visible focus ring for the condensed icon rail.

Ben: One more nit: when overlay opens, ensure the row action menu is dismissed to avoid two overlapping interactive layers. Either auto-close or move the menu to the root and keep it visible above the overlay with correct focus management. I prefer auto-close for simplicity.

Lin: Auto-close is safer. We'll close active row menus when the rail toggles. Implementers: portal popovers, auto-close on toggle, visualViewport handling, CSS var thresholds, env() shim.

design-bot: Added sandbox variants (360, 412, 428, 480), attached visual diffs and accessibility checklist. Tags: mobile-responsive, ux, a11y.
